dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Hero defeats dragon... Princess defeats dragon... Prince gets defeated by princess...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Ugh. I thought I'd be able to find at least one story about mixology here, but nope! Just a bunch of fairytales.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, here's one! Hmm, hero convinces dragon to defend kingdom by plying dragon with alcohol... Hah! What a load of baloney!
